query:
INSERT INTO v2_assets (id, name, path, state, format_type, family, file_size, created_at, updated_at, folder_id)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                    ON CONFLICT(path) DO UPDATE SET
                        updated_at = excluded.updated_at
                    RETURNING id as "id!"
